description:
🐛 Things copy other things and it gets weird. Today, we’re covering every type of mimicry found in nature along with dozens of examples, and explaining the evolution behind these complex traits.

Second Channel: www.youtube.com/@daninbluer
Discord: https://discord.gg/zbsZW8PYfK 
Tip Jar: https://buymeacoffee.com/daninblue 
Channel Memberships:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJd-QMeSx_ARyIcRUFOHL7A/join 
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/daninblue 
TIKTOK: https://www.tiktok.com/@daninblue_ 
IG: https://www.instagram.com/daninblue_/ 

Contact me here: daninblueofficial@gmail.com

[CLOSED CAPTIONS ARE AVAILABLE ON THIS VIDEO]

0:00 Introduction
0:20 Batesian Mimicry
2:27 Aposematism (Warning Colouration)
4:26 Emsleyan Mimicry
6:33 Gilbertian Mimicry
8:15 Mullerian Mimicry
9:54 Automimicry (False Body Parts)
12:14 Browerian Mimicry
14:00 Aristotelian Mimicry (Distraction Displays)
15:29 Camouflage and Mimesis
16:55 Shapeshifting (Mimic Octopus)
18:31 Aggressive Mimicry (Luring Prey)
22:17 Wicklerian Mimicry (Cryptic Aggressive Mimicry)
24:00 Parasitic Mimicry (Kirbyan Mimicry)
26:18 Wasmannian Mimicry (Myrmecophily)
27:45 Reproductive Mimicry (Pouyannian Mimicry)
28:40 Bakerian Mimicry & Dodsonian Mimicry
29:20 Intersexual Mimicry
32:13 Brood-Site Deception
32:52 Wallacian Mimicry
34:41 Vavilovian Mimicry
35:48 Mimicry in Humans

If you’re seeing this, consider leaving a comment. It helps me a lot :)

SOME FURTHER READING:
https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S2352154615000455 
https://www.jstor.org/stable/2097066 
https://academic.oup.com/biolinnean/article-abstract/13/1/1/2682689 

WHO AM I?
Hey, I’m Dan. I double majored in biology and psychology and am now pursuing a PhD in evolutionary biology. I make deep-dive videos about broad topics in evolution, ecology, and psychology and try to give as well-educated and integrative explanations as I can. I plan to stick around on YouTube for a while, so I hope to see you around for years to come! Cheers.
